e.title: insurance-mediation
e.summary: 因果中介分析（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：CDE/NDE 分解 postcode 效应，FCA 代理歧视审计
e.summary_en: Causal mediation (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.0): CDE/NDE decomposition of postcode effects, FCA proxy discrimination audits
e.summary_hk: 因果中介分析（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.0）：CDE/NDE 分解 postcode 效應，FCA 代理歧視審計
e.body: insurance-mediation（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做因果中介分析：把 postcode 等因子的效应分解为合法部分（CDE 受控直接效应）与可疑部分（NDE 自然直接效应）——FCA 代理歧视审计。对 RIAA：歧视审计的核心问题——「postcode 的定价效应多少来自合法的地区风险、多少是种族/收入代理？」（[[insurance-fairness]] 的核心议题）；中介分析给出结构化答案；英国 FCA Consumer Duty 要求公平性证据（[[insurance-governance]] 配套）；与 [[insurance-fairness-ot]]、[[insurance-fairness-diag]] 构成公平性工具箱。
e.body_en: insurance-mediation (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.0) does causal mediation analysis: decomposing the effect of factors like postcode into legitimate parts (CDE controlled direct effects) and suspect parts (NDE natural direct effects) — FCA proxy discrimination audits. For RIAA: the core question of discrimination audits — 'how much of postcode's pricing effect is legitimate territorial risk vs proxy for race/income?' (the central [[insurance-fairness]] issue); mediation analysis gives a structured answer; UK FCA Consumer Duty demands fairness evidence (pairs with [[insurance-governance]]); with [[insurance-fairness-ot]] and [[insurance-fairness-diag]] it forms the fairness toolbox.
e.body_hk: insurance-mediation（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.0）做因果中介分析：把 postcode 等因子的效應分解為合法部分（CDE 受控直接效應）與可疑部分（NDE 自然直接效應）——FCA 代理歧視審計。對 RIAA：歧視審計的核心問題——「postcode 的定價效應多少來自合法的地區風險、多少是種族/收入代理？」（[[insurance-fairness]] 的核心議題）；中介分析給出結構化答案；英國 FCA Consumer Duty 要求公平性證據（[[insurance-governance]] 配套）；與 [[insurance-fairness-ot]]、[[insurance-fairness-diag]] 構成公平性工具箱。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.0 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
